headline: We document characters, capture stories and explore worlds.
description: Toy Boat is a full-service film production team. We set out to navigate the open waters of storytelling, capturing authentic narratives from unique perspectives. We explore the personalities and creative expressions that define a subject, believing that the best stories aren’t just crafted—they’re discovered.
location: Based in Poulsbo, serving the Puget Sound
aboutText:
Toy Boat is me, Andrew Tomayko. For more than 20 years I’ve made films both as part of amazing teams and as a one-man band, directing, shooting and editing commercials, documentaries, music videos and brand stories for clients like Samsung, Condé Nast Traveler and Rhett & Link.

After two decades in Los Angeles, I traded the city for the water. Today I live aboard my sailboat in the Puget Sound. Sailing and filmmaking have a lot in common: you read the conditions, trust your instincts and stay open to where the wind takes you. That sense of adventure shapes everything I make. I go looking for real characters and honest moments, because the best stories aren’t just crafted — they’re discovered.
